field_edits.updated_text: Multifocal atherosclerotic plaques are noted involving the proximal right internal carotid artery, just distal to the carotid bifurcation, producing moderate luminal narrowing, approximately 35–40%. A focal eccentric atherosclerotic plaque/irregularity is noted involving the mid left internal carotid artery without significant luminal stenosis or appreciable reduction in caliber. The remaining internal carotid segments are patent with maintained luminal caliber.
The right vertebral artery is hypoplastic. The left vertebral artery is patent with normal caliber. No significant stenosis, dissection, or flow‑limiting lesion in the visualized segments.

impression:
1. Moderate (35–40%) luminal narrowing of the proximal right internal carotid artery due to multifocal atherosclerotic plaques.
2. Focal eccentric atherosclerotic plaque in the mid left internal carotid artery without significant stenosis.
3. Hypoplastic right vertebral artery.
